title: Updates
intro: Download the new versions while you're online. The one you have keeps working until the new one is ready.
emptyBody: Your maps and archives have the newest version we know of.
failed: The download failed: retry it from Downloads
broken: Routes don't work with the version you have
noRoom: Both versions don't fit at once
blocked_one: One update doesn't fit unless the version you have is deleted first. Tap it to see what to do.
blocked_other: {{count}} updates don't fit unless the versions you have are deleted first. Tap them to see what to do.
noRoomBody: Downloading the new version while keeping the one you have needs {{needed}} free and {{free}} is left. You can delete something you don't use, or delete this version and download the new one.
deleteFirstBody: You can't use it until the download finishes ({{size}}). If the connection drops, you'll be without it until you download it again. Your bookmarks, history and progress are kept.

problem.offline: You need an internet connection. Nothing was deleted.
problem.wifi: Connect to Wi‑Fi first: “Wi‑Fi only” is on. Nothing was deleted.
problem.unreachable: The new version's server can't be reached right now. Nothing was deleted: try again later.
problem.space: Even deleting the version you have there isn't room: it needs {{needed}} free. Nothing was deleted.

homeBody: Some of your data is over 3 months old and has a new version. Update it while you're online.
